content:
leo (infra-oncall): noticing a spike — ~30% of APAC GPU nodes stuck during bootstrap, decrypt errors from keystore, logs show KMS 429s
ops-bot: alert: keystore-decrypt-failures > 50/min in ap-southeast-1
maria (eng-infra): confirming, I'm seeing the same on the provisioning fleet. nodes hit `keystore.Decrypt: ThrottlingException` then fail healthcheck
jia (eng-security): we rolled out the subnet-restricted IAM boundary at 07:05 UTC. it scoped the keystore role to private subnets only — was that across all regions?
sam (eng-sre): KMS side also returning `Rate exceeded`. could be double-hit: role boundary denies fallback path and KMS is throttling retries
leo (infra-oncall): timeline: 06:58 we pushed tighter egress firewall rules for keystore -> privatelink. 07:05 we deployed iam-boundary change. 07:08 nodes started failing boot. correlation looks strong
maria (eng-infra): quick check: nodes in eu/us fall back to regional keystore proxy and boot. APAC nodes have a different NAT/privatelink path that's been blocked by the egress rule
kai (platform): APAC NAT gateway config has a smaller ephemeral port range, might amplify KMS throttling if retries all come from same IP. also the privatelink endpoint for keystore is in a different account — IAM boundary might be inadvertently blocking AssumeRole there
devx: we have a short-term mitigation flag: disable strict keystore validation during bootstrap (devx.keystore.bootstrap_tolerate_failures = true). can flip for APAC to allow nodes to come up then harden after
jia (eng-security): don't love weakening validation across the board. prefer a scoped rollback: revert subnet constraint for the keystore role only in ap-southeast-1 and open egress to the privatelink endpoint cidr for 1 hour
sam (eng-sre): agreed. also request to KMS: increase request quota for the account in ap-southeast-1. I'll open a support case now
maria (eng-infra): how about an immediate firewall allowlist to the keystore privatelink ENI ip ranges? that should be lower blast radius than reverting IAM boundary
leo (infra-oncall): doing that now — adding allow rule for privatelink ENI range 10.244.128.0/20 for 60m and monitoring. posting change in 2m
ops-bot: change: outbound rule added to AZ-2 NAT pool for 10.244.128.0/20 by leo. ticket INF-4921
sam (eng-sre): opened KMS support case #123456 — asked for rate limit bump and guidance on retry backoff best-practices
jia (eng-security): I'll prepare a micro-PR to limit the iam-boundary to only the management account's privatelink role, not the node bootstrap role. small, targeted revert for APAC first
kai (platform): also suggest enabling an ephemeral keystore cache on the bootstrap AMI (local file cache) so transient KMS issues don't brick nodes. patch ready if ops wants it
maria (eng-infra): once leo confirms node counts improving, we'll run a controlled reimage of stuck nodes; avoid mass-terminate which would spike KMS again
leo (infra-oncall): nodes recovering — stuck count down from 120 -> 15 in 10m after allowlist. continuing to watch. will hold the rule for 60m then tighten gradually
devx: created feature flag gate: rollout to apac only; safe toggle if anything regresses
sam (eng-sre): next actions: wait for KMS support reply, monitor error rate for 30m, then merge jia's micro-PR, and remove the temporary allowlist. logging follow-up in INF-4921
jia (eng-security): will also add an audit event rule to alert if keystore AssumeRole is denied by boundary in future
leo (infra-oncall): thanks all. ugly interaction between firewall + iam boundary + regional NAT. main lesson: sequence changes with a staging pilot in each region. I'll write short postmortem and mitigation checklist
maria (eng-infra): +1, and note on cost side — reimages burned ~0.6 GPU-hours and retried operations hit KMS billable api calls. put a cost flag on INF-4921 so finance sees it
sam (eng-sre): logging: adding a sampling trace for bootstrap path to capture exact call rates + source IPs for the next 24h
ops-bot: incident note appended to INF-4921 by ops-bot: initial impact 06:58–07:12 UTC, impacted ~130 nodes, mitigated via allowlist; follow-ups: KMS quota request, IAM micro-PR, bootstrap cache rollout
leo (infra-oncall): closing thread for now. ping me if anything flips back — I'll keep watching until 08:30 UTC
